career_spells.counting_note: Federal regulator now identified; no dated full-time interval established.

career_spells.employer: Office of Maryanne Stuart MP, NSW Member for Heathcote
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary candidate reporting describes Moncrieff as a former political staffer and policy adviser to Maryanne Stuart, the NSW Member for Heathcote; the ABC election guide corroborates State Parliament adviser work. Exact appointment/cessation dates, parliamentary payroll entity, hours, leave, title changes and overlap with federal regulation or campaigning are unresolved. First speech independently confirms state staffer work through an electorate-casework anecdote; it adds no appointment dates or hours. Original Wollongong13August2024 traffic minutes list him representing the Heathcote MP; Sutherland indexed6September2024 forum minutes explicitly name Maryanne Stuart. An earlier indexed Wollongong9April2024 attendance table gives the same representative capacity (full reader oversize). These are personally attributable duty observations in2024, not appointment/cessation boundaries, continuous employment proof, a council job or full-time evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: State parliamentary political-staff work is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Leader reported Moncrieff as Labor's candidate on 23 February 2025 and the ABC records his election on 3 May 2025. It is unclear whether 23 February was the formal preselection date or publication date. Campaign remuneration, hours and overlap with political-staff or regulatory work are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaign activity are excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The frozen official extract has no occupation entries, so public and private employment cannot be reconstructed from the roster alone.
Initial biographies distinguished private finance and federal regulation without naming employers. Follow-up first speech resolves APRA; private employer(s) remain unknown.
The NSW parliamentary adviser role is classified as political staff and excluded from the headline, even though it may have been paid full-time employment.
No employment duration is calculated because every pre-parliament role lacks exact dates and hours.
2026-10-01 follow-up resolves regulator identity from first-person speech and separates concurrent CPSU representation, 2023 referendum organising and LEAN activity.

Searched parliamentary profile, first speech, APRA/CPSU references, finance-employer and publicly indexed professional-profile leads under David and Sidney David Moncrieff. Current APH profile retrieval was restricted. Results for New Zealand ERP, British publishing/aviation and Saudi property professionals were not identity matches. No employment dates/hours or private employer established; future APRA and union historical records are targeted leads, not proof of current findings.

Second follow-up2October2026 resolves undergraduate degree and conferral month using original university roll. Full-name, APRA-domain and postgraduate searches did not identify private employers, APRA dates/hours or postgraduate institutions. Public professional-profile results for Canberra media specialist, Royal Australian Navy, overseas aviation/publishing/ERP and property professionals were not matched to this member and were not adopted. Next leads: later university conferral rolls under Sidney David, public regulator/union delegate records and original staff appointment records; do not repeat generic name-only searches. Totals unchanged and unresolved.

Follow-up3October2026 targeted full legal name in graduate records and APRA/CPSU domains. Only already-recorded2017 undergraduate roll and electoral full-name evidence matched; no later conferral, named private employer or dated APRA/union appointment found. Exclude unrelated Edward James Moncrieff and other academic/industry namesakes. No new career facts or numerical duration adopted. Defer repeated broad searches; future follow-up requires an identifiable employer/qualification lead or original appointment record.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 used exact full-name, APRA/CPSU and Maryanne Stuart adviser queries. Results repeated the first speech, 2017 graduation roll and generic biographies; no private employer, APRA branch/title/dates, postgraduate institution or adviser appointment instrument emerged. An unrelated Canberra media professional was excluded. Broad searches are exhausted pending a new identifiable employer or qualification lead.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New avenue tested: public APRA agreement/bargaining/delegate references under the legal and common names. No personally attributable agreement representative, appointment, title, dates, hours or private finance employer emerged. Results referred to the Moncrieff electorate, unrelated Will/Steve Moncrieff, existing 2017 university roll and later parliamentary questioning. A witness’s comment that a question reflects his background does not establish an employer or term. Preserve existing APRA first-person identification; defer further generic searches until an employer, personnel or postgraduate qualification lead emerges.

2026-10-05 targeted follow-up: exact legal-name Sidney David Moncrieff, postgraduate applied economics/mathematics/statistics and APRA analyst queries through two search engines returned the already recorded first speech and UOW graduation roll, unrelated NBA Sidney Moncrief, overseas finance executives and unrelated university pages. No matching original professional chronology, private employer, postgraduate provider, personal APRA appointment or hours was found. A current DECA speaker listing confirms only elected-office appearance, not former employment terms. Preserve the supported APRA/CPSU and Heathcote office roles; do not assign a graduate year to employment, attribute namesake finance careers, or infer full-time status from APRA institutional bargaining conditions. Follow-up now requires a matching public CV, original employer appointment/cessation document or named postgraduate completion record; avoid repeating the exhausted generic biography and bargaining-representative searches without a new lead.
